events.text: Confirmed — the split SINK rule's closure still drops `do_substitute` after the round-trip, so any SINK that reaches it under `TEST_PICKLE` would `NameError`. The schedule only ever emits a single-range SINK on this path; the bare-SINK substitution shouldn't fire until the range gate has resolved it. Settling the single-range case on an identity rule ahead of the substitution:

events.diff:
pm_split_ranges = PatternMatcher([
   (UPat(Ops.RANGE, name="r")%UPat.cvar("c"), mark_range_mod),
+  (UPat(Ops.SINK, name="x", src=(UPat(Ops.RANGE),)), lambda ctx, x: x),
   (UPat(Ops.SINK, name="x"), lambda ctx, x: do_substitute(ctx, x,
     lambda k,v: k.replace(src=(k.src[0]//v,), arg=k.arg[0:-1]+(0,k.arg[-1]))*v + k.replace(src=(v,), arg=k.arg[0:-1]+(1,k.arg[-1])))),
 ])
